categories.blurb: Develop the screenplay, then line it for coverage.

categories.name: Planning & Scheduling
categories.blurb: Map out pre-production and build the shooting schedule.

categories.name: Visual Planning
categories.blurb: Design the shots, blocking and lighting before you get to set.

categories.name: Shoot-Day Paperwork
categories.blurb: The documents your crew needs before cameras roll.

tools.name: Script Development Tool
tools.desc: Scaffolded scriptwriting: build characters, settings and structure, then write in screenplay format with saved drafts.

tools.name: Script Lining Tool
tools.desc: Upload a script PDF and draw tramlines to map shot coverage, with zig-zags for off-screen lines and notes per shot.

tools.name: Script Breakdown
tools.desc: Tag cast, props, SFX, wardrobe and more straight onto your script PDF, then export category lists, scene-by-scene breakdowns and a colour-coded script.

tools.name: Pre-Production Timeline
tools.desc: A department-by-department roadmap from idea to shoot-ready, with trackable tasks, filters and an editable glossary.

tools.name: Production Schedule Builder
tools.desc: Build a stripboard-style shoot schedule with shoot days, cast legend, locations and a day-out-of-days.

tools.name: Shot List Builder
tools.desc: Plan every shot day by day with custom columns, sunrise and sunset times, breaks and company moves. Track it live on the day.

tools.name: Blocking Planner
tools.desc: Top-down floor plans for actor and camera blocking: rooms, props, movement paths and animated keyframes.

tools.name: Lighting Plan Studio
tools.desc: Draw lighting diagrams from a full library of fixtures and modifiers, with shoot info and a kit list.

tools.name: Lighting Pattern Lab
tools.desc: Learn classic portrait lighting on a 3D head: Rembrandt, loop, butterfly, split, broad and short. Move the key light and see real soft-shadow falloff.

tools.name: Exposure Lab
tools.desc: Explore falloff, collimation and hard vs soft light from arm's length to a kilometre, with an exposure triangle, ND and a live camera preview.

tools.name: False Colour Studio
tools.desc: Plan exposure with false colour: load stills, check levels and contrast ratios, compare frames side by side and export a PDF.

tools.name: Colour Palette Studio
tools.desc: Pull a 3–10 colour palette from any still, check it against 60/30/10, and build a reference deck that blends many stills into one look.

tools.name: Call Sheet Builder
tools.desc: Fill in production, location, scenes, weather and catering details while the call sheet builds alongside.

tools.name: Risk Assessment Builder
tools.desc: Work through hazards, controls, emergency, welfare and sign-off while the risk assessment builds alongside.
